proposals.evidence: DEDR 1479 gives Tamil kāl, Kannada/Telugu kālu, Kota kāl, Toda kōl, Parji kēl, Gadaba/Gondi/Konda kāl ‘leg, foot’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
